gripeverde.field_guide.title: Survivor's Field Manual
gripeverde.field_guide.subtitle: CEDA DISPATCH · UNCENSORED COPY
gripeverde.field_guide.body.infection: The Green Flu accelerates rabies. Ghouls are alive: blue eyes, extreme adrenaline, and mutations.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.pins: PIN attacks remove your control. A teammate must free you; the trapped alert sounds for the whole crew.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.downed: At 0 hearts you enter the downed state. An ally must hold right click for 5 seconds without taking damage to revive you.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.dead: If your incapacity bar reaches 0, you die and spectate without losing inventory. Only a loot defibrillator can bring you back.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.supplies: Ammunition and supplies may dwindle over time. Count every round and search each safe room.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.difficulty: Each level adds challenges, global events, and stronger mobs. INSURGENCY and INFERNUM raise the pressure; other tiers remain in development.
gripeverde.field_guide.body.regroup: The white rally marker tracks allies beyond 3,000 blocks, even across unloaded chunks. Use it to find your crew again.
gripeverde.field_guide.scroll_hint: USE THE WHEEL TO READ THE DISPATCH
